selectionNote: Selected 5 guided Buenos Aires d901 products with live public USD From prices, combined ratings, unique 674x446 named heroes, and verified itinerary POIs. The live catalog supports far more than 20 tours, including preferred private city, gaucho, polo, helicopter, wine, photography, Tigre safari, and additional bike SKUs, but Viator DataDome blocking plus geo-currency dumps (AUD/EUR/GBP/CAD/SEK) blocked many otherwise-strong pages from being verified in USD on a complete product page. No live d901 helicopter page with combined USD+rating+hero was captured. Did not force audio/self-guided/app tours, inactive products, thin-review SKUs, near-duplicates, aggregator-only prices, FX-converted non-USD dumps, or products with unusable heroes. Same completeness constraint documented on Cusco (10), Cabo San Lucas (14), Puerto Vallarta (10), Cancun (13), and Mexico City (11). Premium share is 2/5 (40%) because additional private, helicopter, and gaucho SKUs lacked a complete USD+hero+rating dump.
